title: Billing Rules for Residential Natural Gas Supply Charges and the Monthly Service Fee
content:
**Rule 1 — lines per cycle.** Each billing cycle in which Beacon Ridge supplied gas under Residential Natural Gas Supply produces one energy charge line and, unless waived, one monthly service fee line.

**Rule 2 — status.** Gas supply charges are billed only while the agreement is active, drop pending or closed, as the agreement's status in the company's records shows.

**Rule 3 — energy line.** The energy line's amount is the therms billed multiplied by the applicable rate, rounded half up to the cent. The applicable rate of a fixed plan is the agreement's contract rate for every cycle of the term; the applicable rate of a variable or capped variable plan is set by the gas variable rate rules.

**Rule 4 — fee line.** The fee line carries 0 therms, a rate of 0.0000 and an amount equal to the plan's monthly service fee. It is billed in full for partial cycles and is not billed when the fee is 0.00.

**Rule 5 — dual-fuel waiver.** Holding an active Beacon Ridge residential electricity agreement on the same premise changes the gas fee: when the plan carries the dual-fuel fee waiver and an electricity agreement on the same premise was active on the cycle's billing period start date, no monthly service fee line is billed for that cycle.

**Rule 6 — fee billed despite the waiver.** A fee line billed despite the dual-fuel waiver is a billing error, corrected under the Residential Natural Gas Supply billing correction rules.

### Worked energy line (hypothetical figures)

A fixed plan with a contract rate of 0.6420 per therm bills 87 therms in a cycle: 87 multiplied by 0.6420 is 55.854, rounded half up to the cent, 55.85.

### Fee line decision table

| Plan carries the dual-fuel waiver | Electricity agreement on the same premise active on the cycle's start date | Plan fee | Fee line for the cycle |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | any | not billed |
| Yes | No | above 0.00 | billed in full |
| No | Yes or No | above 0.00 | billed in full |
| any | any | 0.00 | not billed |

A cycle shorter than a full month still carries the full fee where a fee line is billed.
